output.summary: This resolution creates job descriptions for an Executive Director of Systems & Services Improvement, an Executive Director of District Strategy, and a Title IX Coordinator and Investigator. It also revises five existing descriptions, including the Director of the Office of Ombudsperson and the Custodial Field Supervisor. No dollar amount is stated.

output.headline: Backs applying for state grants for full-day preschool and transitional kindergarten facilities
